title: Cima Summer Special: A Spicy, Tropical Cocktail
ldName: Cima Summer Special: A Spicy, Tropical Cocktail
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all of the ingredients to a shaker with ice and shake vigorously, fine strain into a tajin-rimmed rocks glass over ice. Garnish.
Fire TinctureAdd all of the ingredients to a bowl and let the mixture sit at room temperature for 4-6 hours. Afterward, fine strain to remove particulates and add to a bitters dasher bottle.
